provenance_status: verified repository analysis snapshot; regenerate with mvp/build_mvp_data.py when source CSV is present
condition_findings: Heart Failure had the highest mean predicted 30-day readmission rate in the repository analysis.
COPD had the second-highest mean predicted 30-day readmission rate.
Exact condition-level rates are intentionally omitted from this snapshot until regenerated directly from the source CSV.

definitions.err: Predicted readmission rate divided by expected readmission rate under CMS HRRP methodology.
definitions.persistent_high_err: Hospital with at least five reportable conditions and ERR > 1 for every reported condition.
definitions.persistent_low_err: Hospital with at least five reportable conditions and ERR < 1 for every reported condition.

guardrails: ERR is a hospital-level risk-adjusted performance signal, not a complete quality score.
Missing or suppressed values are not converted to zero.
This CMS dataset cannot support individual patient readmission probabilities.
